utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case number IT-00-39-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Krajisnik.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Mr. Harmon, is the Prosecution ready to call its next witness?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. The next witness will be heard in closed session for -- on the basis of decisions known to the parties. We will now turn into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We're now in open session again. Mr. Harmon, I noticed that you're very much concerned about concluding this testimony at a time which would not cause the witness any further problems. Could you give us an indication? The time estimate you've given on the 5th of October sheet is six hours. We lost some time on procedural issues today, but especially in the second half I think we didn't spend too much time on it.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: I would say, Your Honour, I should be able to conclude in an hour tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: In an hour tomorrow morning. So that leaves sufficient time for cross-examination, I take, because from what I understood is that the witness is available this week but not any longer.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: It doesn't seem to be a problem, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Okay. Then I just wanted to verify that. And then quite exceptional for this Chamber, we conclude this session one minute before schedule. We will adjourn until tomorrow morning, 9.00, same courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 7th day of October, 2004, at 9.00 a.m. 18 19 20 21 22 23 24

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.44 p.m,
